item.title: Good Sammy unveils $5.7m Canning Vale transformation, expands inclusive employment
item.description: There’s a new chapter underway at Good Sammy’s Canning Vale headquarters. The WA social enterprise has officially opened its redeveloped head office and training centre, a $5.7 million transformation designed to expand inclusive employment and training opportunities for Western Australians with disability. Backed by a $2.9 million Lotterywest grant and a $300,000 WA Government commitment,…

item.description: During its 40 years of operation, the East Perth Watch House hosted some of Western Australia’s most notorious detainees. Article and photos by Brett Leigh Dicks. item.title: Freo Piazza to get a Big Trash Animal by renowned Portuguese street artist Bordalo II
item.description: Starting this weekend, a world-renowned street artist Bordalo II will be in town – installing one of his iconic Big Trash Animals at the Fremantle Piazza. item.title: Freo’s William Street urban greening upgrade is now underway
item.description: A project aimed at rewilding the City of Fremantle’s urban spaces is now underway, set to make William Street cooler, greener and more pedestrian-friendly. item.title: Built for families, fans and the future, the WACA Ground is back!
item.description: For more than a century, the WACA Ground has been where sporting legends were made – sun-baked days, lightning-fast pitches and some of the most memorable moments in Australian cricket history. item.description: RTRFM has announced that longtime presenter and WA music mainstay Annika Moses will step into the role of Music Director next month, following the departure of Matthew Perrett after four years in the position. item.description: Fresh off the release of his fifth studio album Deadbeat, Kevin Parker has announced a massive four-date Australian arena tour this October that culminates in his home state on October 24 — with fast-rising producer Ninajirachi joining on all shows. item.title: Revealed returns this April with WA’s largest celebration of Aboriginal art
item.description: In 2026, Revealed – Western Australia’s largest Aboriginal art market and exhibition – returns from April 18 to June 14, transforming the Perth Cultural Centre into a statewide celebration of First Nations art and culture. item.title: Australian threatened species list grows to include rare WA wildflowers
item.description: Earlier this month, 36 plants and animals were added to Australia’s threatened species list, including four Western Australian species. The 36 includes five reptiles, one marsupial, one fish species, an insect, mollusc and 25 plants.
